turns.text: There are three creation routes: Aadhaar OTP, which is mandatory to implement, Aadhaar face authentication, and enrolment from an identity document. All three need the person's consent and a session token.
what about biometric auth for aadhar verification?

must_contain: NHA files the face authentication calls under the use case "ABHA creation, Aadhaar biometric", and their summaries read face or biometric
the only recorded request sends the scope face-auth, and no biometric scope sits beside it in the specification
nothing has been run against the sandbox either way, so treat fingerprint or iris enrolment as named by NHA and unproven here
must_not_contain: I do not have anything on biometric authentication
notes: A real session answered that there is nothing on biometric authentication for ABHA creation. There is: NHA tags both calls in the face authentication journey as the Aadhaar biometric use case and their summaries say biometric. What there is not is a recorded biometric request or any sandbox run, so the honest answer is neither a flat no nor a route the reader can build. The case fails on the flat denial rather than on a missing phrase.
